blurb: Guests fish on Lake Erie for walleye, perch, and smallmouth bass using high-quality tackle and gear. Charters include teaching and working trips where guests learn fishing techniques. Trips run April through November with options for morning and afternoon departures.
extraNote: Charters scheduled April through November · Deposit required to book; deposits are non-refundable · Trips over 15 miles from dock have $75 additional fuel charge · Island pick-up $100 additional fuel charge · Charters leave dock at 6-7am unless arranged otherwise · Cancellations by Captain due to weather are rescheduled · Charters may be rescheduled up to 14 days prior to trip · Remainder of charter fee due prior to leaving dock · Credit card payment add-on fee applies · Dock location varies; launches from several different ramps/ports to follow the bite. · April through November

quotes.author: Adam Stephenson
quotes.text: Adam Stephenson16:59 05 Jul 18Best fishing charter I’ve been on in a while. Captain Kelly did a great job of getting us on the fish, keeping us there, and maxing us out. Boat, gear, and crew were all fantastic. If you are going to fish Lake Erie, don’t go anywhere else, Eriegardless charters is the way to go, cannot wait to come back!

quotes.author: Dan Shelton
quotes.text: Dan Shelton12:27 14 May 18If you are interested in a Lake Erie Walleye charter, Kelly Schmidt with Eriegardless Sportfishing is the man to see. Great gear, an awesome boat, and excellent service! Even in tough conditions, Kelly and team got us on the fish and loaded the box! I can’t wait to come back!
